issue.title: routing: Routing history's day files follow the server's day, not the viewer's
issue.body: Sibling of e00fbdbbc (Usage follows the viewer's time zone). Routing history is read from per-day files named by the server's local day, so a remote viewer in another zone picking a day gets the server's day. Reading it in the viewer's zone needs the 2-day margin Usage uses for shared-day reads.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3324-history-viewer-day` (head `0765619b`, on upstream `6afbe3f3`) — Routing history is read in the viewer's day (the files stay the computer's).

**Root cause.** `internal/gateway/history.go` names the day file with `r.Time.Local().Format(dayForm)` and reads a day by that name, so a viewer in another zone sees the server's day; `HistoryRoute` and the GUI endpoint have the same server-day assumption.

**Change.** writers are untouched: files keep the computer's day. The read side takes the viewer's zone (`History(day, loc)`, `?tz=` resolved through `usageapi.ZoneOf`, the zone helper the Usage page already uses), reads the one or two files the viewer's day spans and keeps only that day's routes; `HistoryRoute` searches the viewer's day ±1 in that zone; `trace.go` and the Context tab pass the zone, and the routing page adds `?tz=` at its two calls.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ -run TestHistoryReadsTheReadersDay` → `history_test.go:573: 2026-09-30 there: 1 routes, want none: 23:50 here is 2026-10-01 there` and `:576: 2026-10-01 there: 0 routes, want route 7`
Green: `same command → `ok`; `HistoryRoute` finds a route under either day; the rest of the history tests are unchanged and green` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway`

Known limit, marked in the code with `shortcut:`: the list of days and their numbers are still the files' days — counting a day in the viewer's zone would mean reading every route's time, which `tally` deliberately doesn't do. Say if you want that too.

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 26's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6afbe3f3` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3324-history-viewer-day — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
